question: Two trains of the same length are running on parallel tracks in the same direction at 44 km/h and 32 km/h. The faster train passes the other train in 72 seconds. What is the sum of the lengths (in m) of both trains?
solution:
Given:

Two trains of the same length are running on parallel tracks in the same direction at 44 km/h and 32 km/h. 

The faster train passes the other train in 72 seconds.

Concept used:

While going in the same direction, the relative speed of two objects is the difference between their individual speeds.
